```plato

    // The triangles of one cube, wound counter-clockwise seen from outside the
    // extracted region. Empty for the two uncut configurations.
    MarchingCubesCell(table: Array<Integer>, cell: IntegerVector3, valueAt: Function3<Integer, Integer, Integer, Number>, pointAt: Function3<Integer, Integer, Integer, Point3D>, isoLevel: Number)
        : Array<Triangle3D>
    {
        var c = MarchingCubesCase(cell, valueAt, isoLevel);
        var row = c * 16;
        return MarchingCubesTriangleCount(table, c).MapRange(t =>
            Triangle3D(
                MarchingCubesEdgePoint(table[row + t * 3], cell, valueAt, pointAt, isoLevel),
                MarchingCubesEdgePoint(table[row + t * 3 + 1], cell, valueAt, pointAt, isoLevel),
                MarchingCubesEdgePoint(table[row + t * 3 + 2], cell, valueAt, pointAt, isoLevel)));
    }
```
